LESSON: ORAL EXPRESSION

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.4: Oral Expression
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Oral Expression, part of Listening and Speaking in Grade 6 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How can you speak clearly and effectively on various topics?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen and repeat words and phrases related to the months of the year in the right sequence (一月、二月、 三月、四月、五月、六月、七 月、八月、九月、十月、十一 月、十二月),

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Oral Expression together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to learn: The learner works collaboratively with others as they prepare and present a song for peer role modelling.

• Communication and Collaboration: Teamwork skills are enhanced when the learner participates actively in giving reasons

for their preferences for the various months of the year.

Values:
Unity: The learner displays team spirit as they collaboratively create a rhyme on months of the year using a familiar tune.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Self-awareness: The learner acknowledges the importance of time management by prioritising tasks in their day-to-day life.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner links their learning to Creative Arts on the concept of using imagination and innovative ways to present their ideas

and thoughts.
